hints.title: June 2020 Date Range
hints.text: The reporting timeframe covers June 2020: program_date between "2020-06-01" and "2020-06-30".

hints.title: Child-Friendly Movie Criteria
hints.text: Join TVProgram and Content on content_id, filtering for Kids_content = "Y" and content_type = "Movies".

hints.title: Distinct Movie Title Output
hints.text: Apply select distinct title to eliminate duplicate airings of the same movie.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT DISTINCT c.title
FROM TVProgram t
JOIN Content c ON t.content_id = c.content_id
WHERE c.Kids_content = 'Y'
  AND c.content_type = 'Movies'
  AND t.program_date >= '2020-06-01'
  AND t.program_date < '2020-07-01';
```

complexity.notes: Inner join filtered on indexed dates and category predicates executes in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning dates with string conversions or year/month functions prevents index usage.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Half-open date range [2020-06-01, 2020-07-01) leverages B-tree indexes efficiently.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Distinct selection over equijoin with index-friendly date interval filtering.

solutions.code:
SELECT DISTINCT c.title
FROM TVProgram t
JOIN Content c ON t.content_id = c.content_id
WHERE c.Kids_content = 'Y'
  AND c.content_type = 'Movies'
  AND t.program_date >= '2020-06-01'
  AND t.program_date < '2020-07-01';

SELECT DISTINCT c.title
FROM TVProgram t
JOIN Content c ON t.content_id = c.content_id
WHERE c.Kids_content = 'Y'
  AND c.content_type = 'Movies'
  AND t.program_date >= '2020-06-01'
  AND t.program_date < '2020-07-01';

import pandas as pd

def friendly_movies(tv_program: pd.DataFrame, content: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    tv_program['program_date'] = pd.to_datetime(tv_program['program_date'])
    june = tv_program[(tv_program['program_date'] >= '2020-06-01') & (tv_program['program_date'] < '2020-07-01')]
    merged = pd.merge(june, content, on='content_id')
    filtered = merged[(merged['Kids_content'] == 'Y') & (merged['content_type'] == 'Movies')]
    return filtered[['title']].drop_duplicates()
